explanation: The theorem is the Ax–Sen–Tate approximation lemma. It says that if σα is within δ of α for every σ in the fixing subgroup of K, then α is within B p n * δ of some element of K. Here n bounds the degree of minpoly K α, and B is a constant defined in this library. I searched Mathlib for Ax/Sen/Tate-style results and for norm bounds that involve fixingSubgroup. I found nothing similar. I did not search further by guessing declaration names. Mathlib has no Ax–Sen–Tate lemma and no approximation result of this kind for the completed algebraic closure of Q_p.
